name: clipboard.get
description: Read the current text contents of the system clipboard. Read-only.

format.description: Only 'text' is defined in 2.0. Future minors may add 'image' / 'files'.

windows-modern.description: OpenClipboard + GetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT). UTF-16 native, transcoded to UTF-8 for the wire response.

windows-classic.description: Same OpenClipboard / GetClipboardData. CF_UNICODETEXT has been available since NT 3.1, but pre-NT-5 apps may only publish CF_TEXT — agent falls back to CF_TEXT and transcodes from the active code page.
